content:
# Generated by velnor-workflow. Regenerate; do not hand-edit.
name: Renovate validate
run-name: Renovate validate · ${{ github.event_name }}

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - renovate.json
      - renovate.json5
      - .github/renovate.json
      - .github/renovate.json5
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - renovate.json
      - renovate.json5
      - .github/renovate.json
      - .github/renovate.json5
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: renovate-validate-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate Renovate configuration
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate Renovate configuration
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run --rm \
            -v "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE:/repo" \
            -w /repo \
            ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate:44.93.6 \
            renovate-config-validator --strict --no-global renovate.json
